Data & privacy

Manage the research data stored in your account.

Download your research data

Export your HealthBrowse profile, preferences, saved chats and messages, bookmarks, favourites, and research activity as JSON.

This export excludes authentication-provider logs, credentials, and contact or feedback submissions stored by separate services.

Research storage preferences

Saves public research questions, answers and citations. Personal medical questions are not saved. Turning this off stops new saves; existing chats remain.

Stores public topic names and section numbers. Turning this off also clears saved research activity; chat conversations remain.

Data use

AI questions and relevant evidence are sent to the configured AI provider to generate an answer. Do not include patient identifiers. There are no optional analytics or advertising-sharing controls enabled in this release.

Help

How do I research a topic?

Choose a reading mode on the research desk and search for a public medical question. Open a section or ask the copilot to investigate its sources.

Where do I get my sign-in code?

Look for a recent HealthBrowse confirmation, sign-in, or recovery email. Enter the newest code in the same tab; an earlier code may have expired. Check spam if it does not arrive.

What can I save?

Your account can remember bookmarked topics, favourite resources, preferences, and optional research activity. Use these tools for educational research only.

Delete all chat history?

This permanently removes saved chats, messages and research activity. Your account and saved sources remain. This cannot be undone.
